content: rss-parser (v3.13.0) supports parser.parseString(xmlText) to parse a raw pre-fetched XML string (RSS or Atom), normalizing both into one item shape (title, link, pubDate, isoDate, content, contentSnippet, creator, guid, categories). This lets it be paired with native fetch()+next.revalidate for caching, since parsing is decoupled from fetching.
